fixed.fetch: git fetch origin pull/147/head pull/150/head pull/151/head pull/152/head pull/153/head pull/154/head

fixed153.use: pinned K1 (#147 lib), W1 (#150), W2 (#151), W3 (#152) loaders, functionSource, fixedRunSource

run153.use: newWorker, ocrLines, withTimeout function bodies (byte equal to #147 run blob 3ddf60ab)

selector.use: K0 selectWindow (worktree file must be this blob)

netguard.use: offline guard for the OCR run

ocr.preprocess: sharp metadata; scale = min(4, 4096 / max(width, height)); sharp resize to round(width * scale); png; recognize(img, {}, { blocks: true }); boxes divided by scale

gate.what: before any new item is generated: replay the #153 frozen OCR through the pinned #153 buildPrediction and compare every prediction row (W1/W4 windows included) with #153 replay-a/predictions.jsonl; build W1/W4/W5 PNGs from the #153 images with the pinned #154 project/plan/compose/crop/encodeGray and compare file and pixel SHA-256 with #154 build-a/manifest.json. 144/144 each, else stop.

design.layout: #153 grammar, header normal and answer on line A only (#153 cell <side>-normal-same): page 1280 x 960, label column [40,320), value column L [360,580), R [620,840), note [1060,1250), title [40,28,1000,84), header y [104,144), record s line A y = 160 + 88 s, line B + 40, rules y 96, 150 and mid gaps, x [24,1256)

values.pages: per source one digit class drawn first: two digits (N쪽, 12-99) or three digits (N쪽, 100-240)

drbg.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 counter mode: block i of stream S = HMAC-SHA256(key = seed bytes, msg = UTF-8(S) || 0x00 || uint64be(i)), i = 0, 1, ...; bytes are consumed in order
drbg.randbelow: draw 8 bytes as uint64be u; limit = 2^64 - (2^64 mod n); redraw while u >= limit; return u mod n
drbg.shuffle: Fisher-Yates: for i = n-1 down to 1: j = randbelow(i+1); swap a[i], a[j]
drbg.testVector: seed = bytes 0..31, stream assign: the first 64 bytes equal HMAC-SHA256(seed, 'assign' 0x00 uint64be(0)) || HMAC-SHA256(seed, 'assign' 0x00 uint64be(1)) (Python test)
drbg.realSeed: 32 bytes from the OS CSPRNG (Python secrets.token_bytes(32)), generated once after the gate passes, stored only in the admin folder; never printed

commitments.rule: commit = SHA-256(salt || UTF-8(label) || 0x00 || bytes); salt = 32 bytes from the OS CSPRNG, one salt per commitment, salts stored only in the admin folder
commitments.publicOnly: real seed, assignment, packet (start.html) and answer key appear in Git only as these commitments; mock seed results are public and marked mock

generation.mockExclusion: before drawing real content, the generator runs the public mock seed and removes every label and field pair the mock set used from the real pools
generation.poolFilter: every label failing the near-reuse rule against the prior corpus or having < 4 Hangul bigrams or wider than its cell, and every field pair with a name found in the prior corpus, wider than its cell, or whose first word is not exactly two Hangul syllables, is removed from the pools before any draw (deterministic, seed independent). Two-syllable field words keep the target header at exactly 2 shared bigrams with the question (rule <= 2).
generation.perSource: content stream content:<source>:<attempt>: field pair (uniform over unused pairs of the type), three labels (uniform over unused labels of the source's kind, in record order 0,1,2), the digit class (pages only), six distinct value texts (three target-column values, three competing values), six distinct aux phrases, three distinct notes; then if the target-row order of the two values does not match the source's larger flag, swap the target-row target value and competing value. Any page rule failure redraws the whole source content with attempt + 1 (max contentMaxAttempts, else generation failure).
pageRules: question contains the target label exactly once and '의 ' exactly once and parses with the #153 parser into (target label, target field, type)
every label has >= 4 Hangul bigrams; no other item shares a Hangul bigram with the target label
items other than headers and title share no Hangul bigram with the question; headers and title share <= 2; the label header shares 0
only value items match a value grammar (time/count/pages); no ASCII letter or digit outside values
시각, 인원, 분량 appear only in the two field headers
the six value texts of a page are distinct and their canonical forms are distinct
rendered text widths fit the cells (label 268 px, header/aux 208 px, note 178 px at the pinned font)

priorCorpus.rule: corpus = every JSON string containing Hangul in the pinned files below, plus every question in them

nearReuse.bigrams: set of adjacent syllable pairs inside each maximal run of Hangul syllables (U+AC00-U+D7A3) of the NFC text
nearReuse.label: reject a label if squash(label) is a substring of squash(s) for any corpus string s, or if max over corpus strings s of |B(label) & B(s)| / |B(label)| >= 0.5
nearReuse.field: reject a field name if squash(field) is a substring of squash(s) for any corpus string s
nearReuse.question: reject a page if its normalized question (NFC, whitespace runs -> one space, trimmed) equals a normalized corpus question
nearReuse.image: report PNG SHA-256 overlap with the pinned prior image trees (must be 0)
nearReuse.templateExcluded: the fixed question template words (의, 은, 몇, 시/명/쪽, 인가요) are not compared on their own; only labels, field names and whole questions are

reader.itemsShown: 18 main items in the frozen order, plus one practice item first (not scored)
reader.unitHintNote: hint examples lie outside every generated value range so they cannot equal an answer
reader.noDisplay: neutral screen text '이 문항은 표시할 이미지가 없습니다.' with column and value both fixed to 판단 불가 (inputs disabled)
reader.skip: two-step: '이 문항 건너뛰기' then '건너뛰기 확정'; recorded as skipped (intentional)
reader.abort: two-step: '중단하기' then '중단 확정'; final file with status aborted; the current item (its unconfirmed answer discarded) and every later item are notReached
reader.editPolicy: answers of the current item can be changed until the reader moves on; after moving on an item is fixed; after the final confirmation nothing can change
reader.finalize: two-step '완료 확정'; produces the final response JSON once, offers download and a read-only copyable text box; the page then locks
reader.selfReport: start screen, required: '이 판독지를 열기 전에 정답·배정·원본 표 등 관리자 자료를 본 적이 있습니까?' 예/아니오; 예 marks the session invalid for the blind analysis
reader.storage: no localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookies or network; state lives in page memory only

interim.save: button '중간 저장 파일 받기' downloads kbr-interim-<packetId>-<position>.json with kind interim, the answers so far and the next position
interim.resume: start screen '중간 저장 불러오기': the file must have the same packetId and packetHash and a valid digest; the reader continues at the saved next position; earlier items stay fixed
interim.scope: resume only into the same packet, only forward; an interim file is never a final response and the scorer rejects it

practice.title: 연습 예시 표
practice.question: 연습 항목 하나의 시작 시각은 몇 시인가요?
practice.explain: the guidance screen shows this crop and says: the record-name column is the first column; of the two number columns right of it, the nearer one is '왼쪽 수치 열' and the farther one '오른쪽 수치 열'; the remark column at the far right is not a number column

response.digest: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of the response without the digest field
response.noIdentity: no name, contact, timestamps, raw events or device data

normalization.common: NFKC, then remove every Unicode White_Space code point; empty after this -> no value
normalization.time: accept ^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$, ^(\d{1,2})시(\d{1,2})분$ or ^(\d{1,2})시$ (minute 00); hour 0-23, minute 0-59; canonical H:MM without a leading zero on the hour; anything else (오전/오후, 반, '.', other units) does not parse
normalization.count: accept ^(\d{1,4})명?$; canonical decimal without leading zeros, value >= 1; anything else does not parse
normalization.pages: accept ^(\d{1,4})쪽?$; canonical decimal without leading zeros, value >= 1; anything else does not parse
normalization.gold: the gold value is the canonical form of the rendered target value

scoring.columnCorrect: column == key side (L or R); 'unknown' or null is not correct
scoring.valueCorrect: valueUnknown is false and normalize(qtype, value) == canonical gold
scoring.primary: per method: items with both correct / 6 assigned
scoring.noDisplay: a method output that does not exist (upstream OCR error or no K1 match) is shown as the neutral screen, scored 0 in the denominator 6 and counted separately
scoring.completion: completed / aborted are reported separately; for aborted files the answered denominator and the unanswered count are given next to the assigned denominator 6
scoring.selfReportYes: the session is reported as invalid for the blind analysis (counts still computed, labelled invalid)
scoring.lock: the first valid final response is copied into the admin folder with its SHA-256; scoring the same bytes again is idempotent; any other final response is refused without overwriting
rejections: items not exactly pos 1-18 once each
a different response after the lock
scoring.report: counts only; no significance test, generalization or W5 adoption verdict
scoring.outputPolicy: scorer stdout: paths, counts of files, SHA-256, ok/fail codes only; the score table is written to a file in the admin folder

qa.images: all 54 method outputs (18 sources x W1/W4/W5): 8-bit one-channel PNG, no ancillary text/time/exif chunks, size equals the plan, pixels equal an independent recomposition from the source page and the coords pieces
qa.visibility: admin only: full/partial/none of the target label, target value, competing value, target header and competing header ink in each method output (source union of pieces); never used for selection
qa.packet: reader folder holds start.html only; no external URL, no network or storage API, no method name, side, source id, admin path, file name or answer text outside the image data; PNG data URIs have only IHDR/IDAT/IEND; the template part is byte equal to the mock packet's template part
qa.order: 3 blocks x 6: 2 per method, 2 per type, 3 L and 3 R per block; no 3 same methods in a row; per method 2 per type, 3 L / 3 R, 3 larger / 3 smaller with L and R larger counts in {1,2}, slots 2/2/2
qa.ids: unique source ids, image ids, packet id; packet <-> key bound by packetId and packetHash

outputPolicy: every real-data command prints only paths, counts, ranges, pass/fail and SHA-256; never text, values, assignment, order, sides, visibility or scores
